messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to lock annual offsite date next week. We need final facilitator list, venue constraints, and a short runbook for breakout tech.

Morgan: Poll results — dates that worked: Oct 14–16 or Oct 21–23. Venue shortlist: The Foundry (SF), Harborworks (Oakland), RemoteHouse (hybrid).

Sam: Preference for in-person for workshops. Customer PMs asked for hands-on labs. Also need AV + breakout pods with whiteboards.

Nina: I can draft a 90-min 'Initiatives vs. Signals' facilitation script and a one-pager for exercises.

Devon: Can we lock 6 cross-functional facilitators? 2 Eng, 2 Product, 1 Design, 1 Customer success.

Jamie: I'll build the scribe rotation + table assignment spreadsheet and share a template.

Alex: For the launch-criteria workshop, PRD owners should prepare top-3 release criteria per initiative. Please drop them in #product by EOD Friday.

Morgan: @Alex what's the budget cap per person? Venue costs vary a lot.

Alex: Budget cap is $1.5k per person. Foundry is higher but best AV. Harborworks cheaper but AV reliability risk.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll confirm Foundry AV availability and whether they allow external routers for demo islands.

offsite-bot: Reminder: vendor contracts need 30 days lead time.

Nina: For facilitation, I propose using the 'Decider matrix' and a short pre-mortem exercise to stress test assumptions. Will attach materials Tue.

Alex: Add a 'voice of customer' breakout: each team bring 2 artifacts (support logs, quotes, NPS snippets) to ground decisions.

Devon: To avoid scope creep, we should identify 3 highest-impact initiatives ahead of time. I'll send a prioritization survey to PMs.

Jamie: Survey draft is ready. Link: https://tiny.redwood/offsite-prio

Morgan: Venue checklist: capacity, AV reliability, number of breakout rooms (min 4), catering options, wifi bandwidth (100 Mbps per room), and hotel proximity.

Devon: Quick runbook sketch:
```
09:00 — Welcome & context
09:30 — OKR alignment
10:15 — Breakouts (initiative deep dives)
12:00 — Lunch
13:00 — Prioritization exercises
15:00 — Synthesis + decisions
16:30 — Close
```

Alex: Action summary: Morgan — schedule venue visits by Wed; Sam — confirm AV rules; Nina — facilitation + scripts by Tue; Devon — collect facilitator list; Jamie — assign scribes + send survey; Everyone — upload PRD criteria + customer artifacts by Friday EOD.

Sam: Noted. I'll also check Facilities for potential cost-savings / discounts.

Alex: :party-parrot: Thanks everyone. If you can't make in-person, flag now so we can plan hybrid support.
